name: topdesign-website
description: TOP DESIGN - Website Design, App Design, Digital Marketing, SEO, Interior Design & Printing Services

scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch public/index.html --ext js,css,html --exec "npm run build && node server.js"
scripts.prebuild: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('public/css', { recursive: true }); require('fs').mkdirSync('public/js', { recursive: true })"
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: uglifyjs src/js/site.js -o public/js/site.js && uglifyjs src/js/hero-animation.js -o public/js/hero-animation.js
scripts.deploy: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js

author: TOP DESIGN Team
